This was observed in the [product_name] [article_no].Standard with firmware [version_no]. Earlier firmware versions, such as [version_no] or [version_no], did not display this behavior. analysis.insight_summary: Community feedback indicates that earlier models of [product_name] in the [article_no] series, particularly those running specific firmware versions, suffered crashes or irregular STOP states during network operations. The issue was present in certain firmware releases and could not be patched on those units, but it was resolved in newer versions, which allow firmware updates.
